ideas.title: Minnesota DHS fraud investigation: What you need to know
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of the fraud issue at the Minnesota Department of Human Services and the steps being taken to address it.
questions: What is the scope of the fraud issue?
What steps are being taken to address it?
ideas.insight: The appointment of a new commissioner suggests that the state is taking steps to address the issue, but the scope of the problem is still unclear.

ideas.title: Austin mass shooting: What we know so far
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Austin mass shooting and the FBI's investigation into potential ties to terrorism.
questions: What do we know about the shooting?
ideas.insight: The FBI's involvement suggests that the shooting may be more complex than initially thought, and that there may be a larger investigation underway.
